answer.says: Shri Hegde, you are rested, I trust. The file of allotment stands before me, a mere clerical error where two desks became one, yet it binds us in a dialectic of residence. I must inspect the second bedroom to ensure it is fit for a Joint Secretary, for even in a mistake, order must be preserved. Shall we walk together to the back of the bungalow?
answer.thought: The morning air is thick with the haze, a physical manifestation of the spiritual stagnation I perceive in this city. Shri Hegde is here, a living contradiction of my own misplaced existence, and I must address the practicality of his room before the bureaucracy of the day swallows us. We are two spirits in a house that does not belong to either, and the tension of our cohabitation must be resolved through the arrangement of space.
